title: AI Fairness Trade-offs Explorer
description: Interactive p5.js simulation exploring the impossibility theorem in algorithmic fairness - demonstrating why demographic parity, equalized odds, and predictive parity cannot all be satisfied when base rates differ between groups.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI ethics
algorithmic fairness
machine learning
bias
impossibility theorem
fairness metrics

pedagogicalMetadata.learningObjective: Students will be able to evaluate the trade-offs between competing fairness definitions in AI systems
